_meta.indication: OXERVATE (cenegermin-bkbj) ophthalmic solution 0.002% is indicated for the treatment of neurotrophic keratitis.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, multi-center, double-blinded, vehicle-controlled trial comparing rhNGF 10 µg/mL and 20 µg/mL to vehicle in a 1:1:1 ratio
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with moderate (Stage 2) or severe (Stage 3) neurotrophic keratitis; enrolled 156 subjects from 32 sites in six countries
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Percentage of subjects with complete resolution of corneal staining of the corneal epithelium at Weeks 4 and 8 (FDA-recommended primary endpoint; Weeks 4 and 8 as primary evaluation time points)
pivotal_trials.n: N=156 (52 rhNGF 10 µg/mL, 52 rhNGF 20 µg/mL, 52 vehicle)
pivotal_trials.result: At Week 8, complete resolution of corneal staining was 72% (rhNGF 20 µg/mL) vs 33.3% (vehicle); treatment difference 38.7% (95% CI 20.7%, 56.6%)

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, multi-center, double-blinded, vehicle-controlled trial comparing rhNGF 20 µg/mL to vehicle in a 1:1 ratio (US sites)
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with moderate (Stage 2) or severe (Stage 3) neurotrophic keratitis; enrolled 48 subjects from 11 sites in the US
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Percentage of eyes completely staining free (complete corneal healing) at Week 8 (FDA-recommended primary endpoint)
pivotal_trials.result: At Week 8, completely staining free was 65.2% (rhNGF 20 µg/mL) vs 16.7% (vehicle); difference 48.6% (95% CI 24.0, 73.1); p<0.001

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence >5%) are eye pain, ocular hyperemia, eye inflammation and increased lacrimation; eye pain following instillation reported in approximately 16% of patients
target_moa: Cenegermin-bkbj is a recombinant form of human nerve growth factor; nerve growth factor acts through high-affinity (TrkA) and low-affinity (p75NTR) receptors in the anterior segment of the eye to support corneal innervation and integrity
modality: Recombinant human nerve growth factor protein (recombinant protein), produced in E. coli

rems.type: The Applicant did not submit a proposed REMS or risk management plan with this application; DTOP and DRISK agreed a REMS was not needed given the favorable benefit-risk profile

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee Meeting was held for this application

citations.quote: Cenegermin has been granted the Fast Track, Breakthrough Therapy, and Orphan designations by the FDA.
